TVA — SHIPPED
This is what apps/web/index.html is built from.

A beige console housing with the working area set into it as an amber-phosphor screen. Amber #FFB000 is the interactive colour; a healthy node reads olive and a failed one brick-rust, so the four node states stay distinguishable instead of collapsing into one hue.

Dark and light light the same console rather than recolouring one thing: unlit, the housing recedes to near-black with its labels inverted to tan, so no pale frame surrounds a lit screen; under light the cabinet is beige and the screen becomes a pale readout. These boards show the dark state.

The DISPLAY switch on the lower rail has three positions — auto, dark, light — addressed directly rather than cycled, because a physical selector shows its own state.

The alternatives this was chosen over (Phosphor in green, Substrate, Meridian) were deleted once it shipped; they are in the history if they are ever wanted again.

The variant that did not ship: the same palette with no housing, all screen. It gives back the ~110px the rails cost and loses the thing that makes it read as a workstation rather than just an amber terminal. Kept as the record of that choice.
Sign-in and dashboard only. There is no create-dialog board in this direction — the create flow was designed directly in the app, so index.html is its source of truth.
